deposit(bytes20,bytes32).notice: Locks real ETH into the vault. The depositor must supply their own CreditChain address/public key so the off-chain bridge-validator watchers (api/vault_eth_watch.go) know which account to credit - this contract has no concept of CreditChain accounts itself, it only records the fact and amount of the lock.

depositERC20(address,uint256,bytes20,byt.notice: Locks an allowlisted ERC20 (USDC) into the vault via a standard approve+transferFrom - deliberately not EIP-2612 permit, since real deployed USDC doesn't uniformly support permit across chains/versions (see plan's Phase B design note).

getValidators().notice: Lets anyone view the current validator set for off-chain tooling (the P2WSH redeem-script builder / TxVaultLockAttest submitters don't need this - they read core.BridgeValidatorStore - but external integrators calling this contract directly do).

release(address,address,uint256,uint256,.notice: Releases real ETH or an allowlisted ERC20 back to `to`, once `signatures` contains at least `threshold` valid, DISTINCT bridge-validator signatures over the canonical digest below. Callable by anyone (permissionless finalization) - the caller need not be `to` or a validator themselves, they're just relaying an already-authorized action; this contract's own on-chain check is the entire authorization boundary.

setPerDepositorCaps(uint256,uint256,uint.notice: Adjusts the per-depositor native-unit caps (see the mapping declarations above) - the USD value of a fixed native-unit figure drifts with market price, so this needs to be adjustable without a redeploy, same threshold-signed pattern as every other self-governance action here.
